chapter: Hampton, New York and Lee's own band
title: Union forces Lester to play from the floor as a guest
summary: Because of the separate locals, Lester had to wait on a milk box and play three tunes in each set from the floor for six weeks while his transfer went through.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: And so -- as I stated before, they thought that I was gonna axe Bumps and have Lester in the band, but I intended to have both of them in the band.

So they wouldn't allow Lester to play with the band when he first arrived, and they told him that he had to appear as a guest; he could play three sets a night --but he had to play on the floor, he couldn't play on the bandstand with the band. And so he would come to Billy Berg's, and he had a little; he would set out back all night on a milk box waiting to come on, and we would play a set; we would play 3 sets a night, and then we would introduce Lester Young, and he'd come out and stand in the middle of the floor and play 3 tunes. He couldn't play but 3, and then he wouldplay 9 songs a night.
